uses.condition: Approach a still-closed Tunnels grain gate with less grain than that gate requires. The reminder radius is smaller than the gate-opening radius.
uses.repeat: A shared Tunnels reminder cooldown must be zero. A request resets it to 60 + a random byte (0–255) game updates; this is not a seconds timer.

uses.condition: Approach one of City Entrance's closed grain gates with less than its native 10 / 20 / 30 grain requirement, inside that gate's proximity radius.
uses.repeat: A shared City Entrance reminder cooldown must be zero. A request resets it to 60 + a random byte (0–255) game updates; this is not a seconds timer.

events.title: Need Super Jump

uses.condition: City Square's updater requests this reminder while Flik lacks the Super Jump flag. It is a periodic reminder, not a failed-jump input check.
uses.repeat: The reminder timer must be zero. It resets to 600 + a random byte (0–255) game updates, even when Flik already has Super Jump. A nonzero timer decrements once per update.

events.caveat: Dormant in the normal PC City Square banks: the updater requests sample 64, but banks 9, 21 and 22 do not load it. Startup bank 1 does. Replacing this WAV alone does not activate the reminder. No automatic bank restoration is performed.

events.title: Super Jump acquired
events.condition: Collect a Super Jump power-up. The native handler also sets Flik's Super Jump flag (bit 0x20). This is different from the missing-Super-Jump reminder.

events.title: Invincibility acquired
events.condition: Collect an invincibility power-up while the invincibility timer is below 1. Collecting another while the timer is active refreshes it without requesting this line.

events.title: Health / general pickup
events.condition: Collect the native health pickup. The handler increments Flik's health and requests this response.

events.title: Super Berry pickup
events.condition: Collect the native Super Berry power-up (pickup-effect selector 0x23); the handler selects berry weapon 1.

events.title: Homing Berry pickup
events.condition: Collect the native Homing Berry power-up (pickup-effect selector 0x21); the handler selects berry weapon 2.

events.title: Mega Homing Berry pickup
events.condition: Collect the native Mega Homing Berry power-up (pickup-effect selector 0x24); the handler selects berry weapon 4.

events.title: Gold Berry pickup
events.wording_candidate: Gold berry! I can do some damage with this!
events.condition: Collect the native Gold Berry power-up (pickup-effect selector 0x22); the handler selects berry weapon 3.

events.title: General pickup · This I can use
Hurt reaction · variant 2
events.wording_candidate: Short vocalization; no reliable word transcription.

groups.title: Collect ordinary grain
groups.condition: Collect a grain pickup (selector 0x14), either a stored level collectible or an effect pickup. This is not the grain-gate reminder. Grain is still collected when speech is suppressed.
groups.selection: First random byte & 15 must be zero: nominally a 1-in-16 opportunity, not a line on every grain. Outside Training, the next random byte's low bit selects USGN009 or USGN010. These are the only two ordinary-grain candidates in these handlers; other grain-related wording does not establish another variant.
groups.guards: Suppressed in Training (engine 17), while tracked speech is busy, in Flik state 2, with flag 0x04, or while speech blocker 00572C20 is set. No round-robin or immediate-repeat avoidance is present in these two grain paths. The chance statement assumes uniformly distributed random bytes; it is not a measured frequency.

groups.title: Collect letters, blueberry or seed tokens
groups.condition: The stored-collectible handler requests the shared response pool when collecting F/L/I/K letters (0x10–0x13), the blueberry (0x20), or seed tokens (verified selectors 0x29–0x2B). This is a different pool from ordinary grain. USGN050 is also requested directly for a health pickup.
groups.selection: The next random byte & 7 indexes a weighted eight-entry table: USGN050, USGN052, USGN051, USGN028, USGN043, USGN050, USGN052, USGN051. If the chosen cue equals the last shared-dispatcher cue, the game substitutes this pool's previously saved fallback. It is not a five-item round-robin, and probability depends on prior state.
groups.guards: The shared-pickup pool returns without choosing speech in Training (engine 17). Elsewhere state 2 or speech blocker 00572C20 suppresses dispatch. The matching collectible must exist and overlap Flik; a loaded WAV alone does not cause an event. These verified uses are not an exhaustive list of every caller of the same pool or recording.

groups.title: Take nonfatal damage
groups.condition: The normal damage handler accepts a hit, decrements the native health field and finds it still nonnegative. It then requests the hurt pool. An invulnerability timer or invincibility can prevent this response. The fatal branch requests a different cue, not this pool.
groups.selection: The next random byte & 7 indexes: USGN090, USGN091, USGN108, USGN109, USGN092, USGN090, USGN091, USGN108. A repeated last shared-dispatcher cue is replaced by the previously saved fallback for this pool. This is not a round-robin; not every damage source has been traced upstream.
groups.guards: Native damage acceptance guards remain intact. The shared speech dispatcher can additionally suppress these cues in state 2 or while speech blocker 00572C20 is set. No Training-specific suppression exists in this pool.
